title.description: Short human title, e.g. 'Counters at the ticket window'.

focus.description: What this lesson drills, in one phrase.

preamble.description: Optional short teaching note shown before the first exercise. Markdown. Omit for pure review lessons.

kind.description: The first seven grade locally and work offline. 'translation' and 'freeResponse' need the teacher. Use 'set' for a numbered drill: several short items under one instruction, the way a textbook groups practice.

prompt.description: The question. May carry furigana in the inline form 漢字[かんじ] -- the app hides readings by default and reveals them on request.

instruction.description: REQUIRED in practice: say exactly what the learner should type, e.g. 'Type only the particle.' or 'Write the whole sentence.' Without it a fill-in-the-blank is ambiguous -- the learner cannot tell whether you want the fragment or the full sentence. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

acceptedAnswers.description: cloze and digitEntry. Every spelling that counts as correct; the grader normalizes whitespace and full/half-width forms before comparing. Write these WITHOUT furigana -- they are compared against what the learner types.

tokens.description: reorder only. Presented shuffled by the app -- supply them in a natural, NOT already-correct order.

correctOrder.description: reorder only. Indices into tokens, giving the correct sequence.

pairs.description: matching only. Every pair must carry real text on both sides -- do not pad the list with blank entries to reach a count.

front.description: flashcard only. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

back.description: flashcard only. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

referenceAnswer.description: translation and freeResponse. A model answer the teacher grades against; never shown before the learner submits. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

explanation.description: Why the answer is what it is. Shown after answering. Explain the rule, not just the fact. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

audioText.description: Text to speak for listening exercises. Target language only.

reviewItemIds.description: IDs of spaced-repetition items this exercise tests. Drives review_results[] on submit. Empty for brand-new material.

passage.description: Reading-comprehension text this exercise asks about. Several consecutive exercises may share the SAME passage verbatim to ask several questions about one text -- repeat it identically and the app shows it once. May carry furigana in the same 漢字[かんじ] form.

items.description: 'set' only. Several short items practising ONE point, answered together on one screen and graded item by item. This is the shape of a textbook drill: 'Fill the gaps' followed by a-h. Prefer it over eight separate exercises whenever the items share an instruction -- repetition on one point is what builds automaticity.

prompt.description: One item. Mark the gap with ＿＿. May carry furigana as 漢字[かんじ].

acceptedAnswers.description: Every spelling that counts. No furigana.

hint.description: Optional cue shown beside the gap, like the infinitive in '___ (ir)'. Use for the dictionary form of a verb, a counter, or an English gloss.
